title: Most attention heads are doing nothing
text: I’ve been poking at a 6-layer transformer. Attention entropy collapses hard after layer 4.

title: Most attention heads are doing nothing
text:
The measurement
Standard Shannon entropy over each head’s attention distribution:
\[H_h = -\sum_i p_i \log p_i\]


Code
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.hist(np.random.beta(2, 5, 1000) * 4, bins=40, color="#b04a24")
plt.xlabel("entropy (nats)")
plt.show()








Figure 1: Entropy by layer





As Figure 1 shows, most heads sit near zero.
